plan.summary: Add 9 national tours of theatrical productions (BRO-4931 owner decision: every touring production is tracked, with or without a Broadway parent). Three are booked-ahead standalone tours confirmed from the Tours To You schedule (Dolly Parton's Smoky Mountain Christmas Carol, The Unauthorized Hallmark-ish Parody Musical, Dr. Seuss' The Cat in the Hat). Six had their current-era launch checked by hand against two sources each (Mystic Pizza, Clue second tour, Menopause The Musical 25th anniversary tour, Spamilton, The Bodyguard, All the Devils Are Here). All are provisional tour entries with no closing date. Heathers and Mexodus are left out until their tours are confirmed.

show.synopsis: Mystic Pizza: A New Musical adapts the 1988 film about three young waitresses — best friends Kat, Daisy, and JoJo — navigating love and self-discovery at a beloved pizzeria in Mystic, Connecticut, set to a jukebox score of '80s and '90s pop hits. This limited engagement at Paper Mill Playhouse followed prior stagings at Ogunquit Playhouse (2021 world premiere), the John W. Engeman Theater (2022), and La Mirada Theatre (2024), ahead of a 2026 national tour.
